baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive rujjat and its cognate accusative rajjan enclose al-ard with two occurrences of r-j-j.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lower supporting field is forcibly moved until it loses steadiness; the repeated root makes the motion exhaustive rather than incidental.

activation_trace.role: Shaking until disturbance supplies the violent motion and its intensified recurrence.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the total supporting field acted upon.

changed_reading.after: The whole lower support is made to oscillate violently and comprehensively.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-ard can image clinging and weight toward the ground, while r-j-j can image a mass that goes, returns, and sways.
baseline_models.mechanism: What normally fixes bodies and orientation becomes itself mobile, cancelling the distinction between stable support and supported thing.

activation_trace.role: A swaying mass that moves back and forth supplies failed positional stability.
Clinging and weighting toward earth supplies the ordinary mechanism of groundedness that is overturned.

changed_reading.after: Groundedness itself is revoked because the usual anchor becomes the moving mass.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The r-j-j inventory joins confused perception or speech with the collective sound of people or thunder.
baseline_models.mechanism: The convulsion is apprehended not only as displacement but as an enveloping roar that disorders recognition.

activation_trace.role: Muddled speech or darkness contributes perceptual confusion as an effect of the shaking.
The sound of a crowd or thunder contributes the convulsion's audible register.

changed_reading.before: The event is silent mechanical motion.
changed_reading.after: The earth's motion arrives as a disorienting collective roar as well as a physical shock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed arrival of the Event and the paired lowering and raising turn the shaking into the material operation of a vertical reversal.

activation_trace.role: Violent disturbance supplies the operation capable of undoing settled levels.
Falling and becoming fixed makes the surrounding event an accomplished arrival rather than a possibility.
Lowering after height supplies one pole of the redistribution.
Raising supplies the opposed pole, making the motion directional rather than random.

structural_cues: The repeated temporal idha in 56:1 and 56:4 nests the shaking inside the Event.
The compact antithesis of 56:3 immediately precedes the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accomplished arrival and opposed lowering and raising; I infer that the shaking mediates their reversal, while they could alternatively be adjacent descriptions without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The ground undergoes an isolated convulsion.
changed_reading.after: The arrived Event uses convulsion to redistribute what had occupied high and low positions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Agitation initiates a material cascade: compact elevations lose cohesion through crushing and mixing, become fine particulate, then spread through the air.

activation_trace.role: Shaking until disturbance supplies the cascade's initiating energy.
Crushing, wetting, and mixing supplies loss of cohesion after agitation.
A high solid aggregation supplies the initially resistant material.
Fine dispersed dust supplies the particulate state produced from solidity.
Scattering supplies the final outward distribution of the particles.

structural_cues: The focus and 56:5 use parallel passive verbs with cognate accusatives.
Fa-kanat in 56:6 presents the dust state as a result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disturbance, compact mountains, comminution, fine dust, and scattering; I order them as a causal phase transition, though the images could be cumulative depictions rather than discrete stages.

changed_reading.before: The earth shakes but remains materially intact.
changed_reading.after: The shaking begins the dismantling of solid geography into airborne dispersed matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once common ground cannot hold a shared position, the human plural is reconstituted as three classes whose relations are marked by precedence and nearness.

activation_trace.role: Ground as the locus of clinging and weight supplies the common positional basis that fails.
A swaying mass supplies destabilization of fixed placement before reclassification.
A kind or class supplies the new social units formed after destabilization.
A whole articulated into three parts supplies the sorting structure.
Precedence supplies a relational rank that replaces undifferentiated shared footing.
The privileged nearness of intimates supplies the resulting positional status.

structural_cues: The scene turns from earth and mountains in 56:4-6 to second-person plural humanity in 56:7.
Threefold enumeration is followed by repeated class labels in 56:8-10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed grounding followed by three classes, precedence, and nearness; I infer a sieve-like social remapping, while the classification may instead merely follow the physical scene chronologically.

changed_reading.before: The shaking affects terrain around an unchanged human order.
changed_reading.after: The loss of common footing also functions as a social sieve that remaps collective positions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's roar and confusion open an acoustic disorder that the later scene reverses: mixed noise is excluded and repeated safe speech remains.

activation_trace.role: Confused speech or darkness supplies the focus's cognitive-acoustic disorder.
Crowd or thunder sound supplies the focus's roar.
Auditory perception makes the later exclusion explicitly acoustic.
Mixed noisy sound supplies the acoustic condition explicitly removed.
Articulated utterance supplies ordered sound in place of confused noise.
Freedom from harm supplies the semantic quality of the surviving repeated utterance.

structural_cues: 56:25 negates what is heard and 56:26 replaces it through an exception.
The doubled r-j-j in the focus is answered at the window's end by doubled salam.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies roar, confusion, excluded mixed noise, and repeated safe utterance; I infer a movement from acoustic disorder to order, while the later speech may describe reward without resolving the focus's sound.

changed_reading.before: The earthquake is merely loud and disorienting.
changed_reading.after: Its acoustic rupture begins a wider replacement of confused noise by intelligible, harmless speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the carpet branch of al-ard is remote from the ordinary referent Earth; it remains anchored by focus branches and is sharpened by later woven couches and reclining, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-ard has a thick-carpet branch, and r-j-j supplies the act of shaking that support.

activation_trace.role: A thick carpet supplies a bounded analogy for earth as an extended support surface.
Forceful shaking supplies the action applied to that support surface.
Tightly interwoven construction supplies a later contrast of support restored as coherent fabric.
Reclining in reliance on a support sharpens what the shaken world-floor had made impossible.

changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the world-floor is shaken like a great carpet, dislodging settled relations before secure support reappears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because q-w-l reaches q-l-l through a non-dominant packet mapping; it remains formally packet-valid and echoes r-j-j through oscillation, but downstream prose should call it a sound-pattern analogy rather than an etymology or translation of qila.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled r-j-j frames uncontrolled vibration, while the ending repeats a spoken formula.

activation_trace.role: Thunderous or collective sound supplies the uncontrolled initial vibration.
The split-root branch of rattling movement supplies a deliberately contained echo of the focus's vibration.
Repeated safety speech supplies the measured pattern into which the earlier roar is transposed.

changed_reading.before: The shaking's repetition only intensifies destruction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, uncontrolled rattle is later answered by measured verbal repetition: salam, salam.

strongest_changes: The shaking becomes the operation by which the arrived Event reverses high and low.
It initiates a material phase change from compact geography to dispersed particulate.
Loss of common footing opens a second mechanism of human sorting into relational classes.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled focus root supported simultaneous mechanical, positional, and acoustic readings; ordered context then extended them into inversion, disassembly, classification, and a qualified restoration of support and speech.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from geophysical collapse to social sorting is reader-supplied rather than grammatically explicit.
Lowering and raising may be topographic, social, or deliberately coactive.
The carpet and split-root rattle readings require explicit exploratory qualification.
